title: 第11章 大赚一笔
slug: 从素晴开始成为海贼王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“为什么？你们为什么不叫醒我！”

船舱里，惠惠拎着林北的衣领，大发雷霆。

“不是你说的吗？‘发现任何异常都要立刻叫醒全船，别擅自做主处理任何事情’这句话是不是你说的？看着我的眼睛！你说话呀！”

林北默默把视线挪向一边。

“惠惠，你不要这样，林北先生他……”

“你以为我没在说你吗？这家伙就算了，为什么连你也不叫醒我！这可是和海贼的决战，是展现我爆裂魔法威力的重要时刻！”

悠悠也默默移开了视线，不敢多看惠惠一眼。

不如说，他们俩正是因为太担心发生这种事，才默契地没叫醒她。

“这次的赏金是五百万，大不了分你一百万。”

惠惠立刻松开了手，仔仔细细将林北被揪皱的衣领抚平。

“对不起，尊敬的林北先生，刚才是我太大声了，还请您千万别往心里去。我为方才的失礼，献上最诚挚的道歉。”

一百万啊！这可是一百万！有了这笔钱，就再也用不着为食物发愁了——太棒了！

“我去隔壁船上清点一下物资，你们两个看住俘虏。”

“保证完成任务！”

别看亚尔丽塔在这个世界只是不入流的小海贼，但家底却攒了不少。

船上零零碎碎的值钱物拢到一起，粗略估算也有将近两百万贝利。

唯一可惜的是，船身被悠悠的火球术烧穿了几个大窟窿，估计很难再卖出像样的价钱。

但不管怎样，这一趟绝对称得上盆满钵满。

将所有贵重物品打包搬回自家船上，林北把除亚尔丽塔之外的俘虏挨个丢进海里，只留下这坨“行走的五百万”捆在桅杆底下。

忙完这一切，他才忽然意识到哪里不对。

悠悠和惠惠呢？不是让她们看着俘虏吗？

正纳闷着，两人不知从哪兴冲冲地围了上来。

“林北！你猜我们在海上发现了什么好东西！”

“……嗯？”

林北眉头一挑。

虽然还不清楚具体发生了什么，但看他们俩的样子……

准没好事！

跟着她们来到船尾甲板，一只巨大的木桶赫然立在中央。

惠惠满眼放光。

“这是我在大海上发现的！好像是从很远很远的地方漂过来的，我们费了好大力气才捞上来呢！”

林北沉默了。

不是叫你们看着俘虏吗？这就是你们看的结果？

"Why? Why don't you wake me up!"

In the cabin, Huihui grabbed Lin Bei's collar and became furious.

"Didn't you say that? 'If you find any abnormality, wake up the whole ship immediately, don't make the decision to deal with anything without authorization.' Did you say this? Look at my eyes! You speak!"

Lin Bei silently moved his gaze to the side.

"Huihui, don't do this, Mr. Lin Bei..."

"Do you think I'm not talking about you? Forget this guy, why didn't you even wake me up! This is the decisive battle with the pirates, and it's an important moment to show off the power of my explosive magic!"

Youyou also silently looked away, not daring to look at Huihui.

Rather, it was because they were too worried about something like this happening that they made a tacit agreement not to wake her up.

"The reward this time is five million. At the worst, I can give you one million."

Huihui immediately let go of her hand and carefully smoothed Lin Bei's wrinkled collar.

"I'm sorry, dear Mr. Lin Bei, I was too loud just now. Please don't take it to heart. I offer my most sincere apology for the rudeness just now."

One million!This is one million!With this money, you’ll never have to worry about food again – great!

"I'll go to the next ship to check the supplies. You two can keep an eye on the prisoners."

"Promise to complete the mission!"

Even though Arrita is just a low-class pirate in this world, she has accumulated a lot of wealth.

The scattered valuables on the ship were gathered together, and it was roughly estimated that there were nearly two million beli.

The only pity is that several large holes were burned through the hull of the ship by Youyou's fireball technique. It is estimated that it will be difficult to sell it for a decent price.

But no matter what, this trip is definitely a rewarding one.

After packing all the valuables and carrying them back to his own ship, Lin Bei threw the prisoners except Arrita into the sea one by one, leaving only this "walking five million" bundled under the mast.

After doing all this, he suddenly realized something was wrong.

Where are Yuyou and Huihui?Shouldn't they be asked to look at the captives?

Just as he was wondering, the two people gathered around him excitedly out of nowhere.

"Lin Bei! Guess what good things we found on the sea!"

"...huh?"

Lin Bei raised his eyebrows.

Although it's unclear what happened specifically, looking at the two of them...

It's definitely up to no good!

Following them to the stern deck, a huge wooden barrel stood in the center.

Megumin's eyes sparkled.

"I found this on the sea! It seems to have drifted here from a very far away place. We spent a lot of effort to catch it!"

Lin Bei was silent.

Didn’t I tell you to look at the prisoners?Is this the result you see?
